title: Getting Control of Your Life: The Five Stages of Mastering Workflow
heading: Getting Control of Your Life: The Five Stages of Mastering Workflow
supportNotes: The five-stage workflow is the chapter's core architecture.
The chapter depends on sorting logic for actionable and non-actionable inputs.
Weekly Review is explicitly part of the system, not an optional add-on.
Control comes from defining work before choosing what to do.
